defects.text: if ($afterPrefixCharacter -cne $beforePrefixCharacter -or -not :IsNullOrEmpty($afterPrefixCharacter)) { throw (\'Prefix character changed or remained: \' + $sheetName + \'!\' + $cellAddress) }

classification.confirmed: The two corruptions are present in the rendered code editor DOM and the DOM serialization is byte-identical to the preserved Windows clipboard payload.
classification.ruled_out: These two corruptions were not introduced by the code-copy control, clipboard encoding, repository newline normalization, or PAD.
classification.not_claimed: The model or service's hidden internal cause is unknown.
classification.safety_effect: The unmodified r9 payload remains unsafe and was correctly stopped before PAD.
